MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p) OR EXISTS { (p)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0 }
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS ps
WHERE size(ps)>=2
UNWIND ps AS k
RETURN DISTINCT k AS id, 'person' AS kind
UNION
MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
MATCH (p:Person)
WHERE (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p) OR EXISTS { (p)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0 }
WITH i,pr,count(DISTINCT p) AS n
WHERE n>=2
RETURN DISTINCT pr.projectKey AS id, 'project' AS kind

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
WITH i, p.personKey AS k RETURN i.issueKey AS issue, k
UNION
MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0
RETURN i.issueKey AS issue, p.personKey AS k

CALL () {
MATCH (i:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
RETURN i, p
UNION
MATCH (p:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) WHERE t.seconds>0
RETURN i, p
}
WITH i, count(DISTINCT p) AS n, collect(DISTINCT p.personKey) AS ps
WHERE n>=2
MATCH (i)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
WITH collect(DISTINCT pr.projectKey) AS prs, collect(ps) AS l
UNWIND l AS x UNWIND x AS k
WITH prs, collect(DISTINCT k) AS people
UNWIND (prs+people) AS id
RETURN id, CASE WHEN id IN prs THEN 'project' ELSE 'person' END AS kind
